ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a transition-state structure in which a benzene ring is fused with a nitrogen-containing five-membered ring; the central carbon on the right is connected to R and OH, and there is a dashed/partial bond between the central carbon and N; above there is also a substituent part connected to S, and S is further connected to an alkyl/methyl line segment. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows; bonds involving hydrogen such as N-H and O-H are not counted. Then reason: Count according to the specified method. The benzene-ring skeleton has 6 non-hydrogen bonds. In the fused five-membered ring, excluding the edge shared with the benzene ring, there are 4 additional non-hydrogen bonds: from the upper fused carbon to the carbon bearing S, from the carbon bearing S to the central carbon, the dashed/partial bond from the central carbon to N, and from N to the lower fused carbon. The substituent part has another 4 non-hydrogen bonds: carbon to S, S to the methyl/alkyl carbon, central carbon to R, and central carbon to the O of OH. Excluding N-H and O-H, and ignoring arrows, the total is 6 + 4 + 4 = 14.

raw_record.question_text: In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen. Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First count the benzene ring framework as 6 non-H bonds. Then count the extra bonds that make the fused five-membered ring beyond the shared benzene edge: fused top carbon to the S-bearing carbon, S-bearing carbon to the central carbon, central carbon to N including the dashed/partial bond, and N to the lower fused carbon = 4 more. Count substituent bonds: ring carbon to S, S to methyl/alkyl carbon, central carbon to R, and central carbon to O of OH = 4 more. Exclude N–H and O–H and disregard all arrows. Sum 6 + 4 + 4 = 14.

先描述图像：图中是一个苯环与一个含氮的五元环稠合的过渡态结构；右侧中心碳连有 R 和 OH，中心碳与 N 之间有虚线/部分键；上方还有一个连到 S 的取代部分，S 再连到一个烷基/甲基线段。图中有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头；N-H 和 O-H 这类涉及氢的键不计入。
再推理：按指定方法计数。苯环骨架有 6 个非氢键。稠合五元环中，除去与苯环共享的边之外，额外有 4 个非氢键：上方稠合碳到带 S 的碳、带 S 的碳到中心碳、中心碳到 N 的虚线/部分键、N 到下方稠合碳。取代基部分再有 4 个非氢键：碳到 S、S 到甲基/烷基碳、中心碳到 R、中心碳到 OH 的 O。排除 N-H 和 O-H，并忽略箭头，总数为 6 + 4 + 4 = 14。
